title: Axiomatic Justification in Constructive Morse Set Theory
summary: Working within Constructive Morse Set Theory (CMST), we introduce axioms for a new notion, jst Pp, intended to capture what it means for P to prove, or justify, p under the BHK interpretation of intuitionistic logic. Since it makes no distinction between terms and formulae -- every term is also a formula, and vice versa -- CMST is well suited to our axiomatic development of justification theory within set theory itself.
